{{Quote|We, too, lost a citizen yesterday on the Ghorman Plaza. We, too, are grieving and wondering what more we might've done to stop this insurrection. And to those who fail to see this as an emergency, I say, "What will you tell your people when it is one of your citizens who've been slaughtered?"|Karloo, in a session of the senate regarding the Ghorman Massacre|<ref name="Welcome" />}}
[[Senator]] '''Karloo''' was a [[Politics|politician]] in the [[Imperial Senate]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Following the [[Ghorman Massacre]]<ref name="Welcome" /> in [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{Andor|Messenger}} dates the events of {{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}} to [[2 BBY]].</ref> the senate held a session to discuss the events. Karloo was one of several senators who spoke within the [[Galactic Senate Chamber]] as part of the [[Standard day|day's]] agenda. Karloo remarked how one of their constituents [[Death|perished]] during the event, and stated that this event should be considered an emergency. Following Karloo's remarks, [[Senior Senator]] [[Erveen]] yielded their time to Senior Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa]], who used Karloo's emergency statement as an excuse to invoke [[Article 17-252]], allowing him to further yield his time to Senior Senator [[Mon Mothma]]. Senator Mothma used her time to denounce [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] as responsible for the Ghorman Massacre. Mothma subsequently made an [[escape from the Senate]]<ref name="Welcome" /> and stated the [[Declaration of Rebellion]] above [[Dantooine]]'s orbit, officially creating the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Secret Cargo">{{Rebels|Secret Cargo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|…I thank the Senator from Ilum for yielding time so I may extend my condolence to her proud planet.|"Senator C" in the script for "Welcome to the Rebellion"|<ref name="Script">{{Disney|subdomain=assets.debut|url=documents/Andor%20209%20--%20POST%20FINAL%20--%203.3.24%5B1%5D.pdf|text=Episode #209 "Welcome To The Rebellion" Script|format=PDF}}</ref>}}
Karloo appeared in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''<ref name="Welcome" /> which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> Karloo was portrayed by [[Nicholas Blane]] in the episode.<ref name="Welcome" /> The character was referred to only as "Senator C" in the script, which also featured additional dialogue referencing a senator from [[Ilum]] that was cut from the final episode.<ref name="Script" />
